note: F-001 §274 dry-run ledger fixture. SYNTHETIC: symbolic amounts only (P = list price, r/f = processing rate/fixed charge UNVERIFIED per §267, q = payout fee UNVERIFIED). No real transaction. Rows follow Business/ledger/SCHEMA.md plus PROPOSED fields marked proposed_*.

rows.evidence: SOURCE-OBSERVED when copied from a Gumroad sale record; never INFERRED for amounts
rows.proposed_tax_collected: <amount shown on the sale record, or MISSING>

rows.fees: -(fees returned by platform, from the refund record; MISSING if not shown)

checks: K1 every income/expense row: net == gross - fees (income) or net == gross (expense)
K2 a refund row names proposed_reverses_row and its gross is the negative of that row's gross
K3 sale + full refund with all fees returned sums to net 0; with fees not returned, the residual equals the unreturned fees and is recorded, not estimated
K4 no amount field may be filled by estimate: unknown -> the literal MISSING
K5 tax collected by the platform is not income to the business and is kept out of gross
